name: earningsdesk
description: Cloudflare Worker serving the EarningsDesk static site and live-refresh API

scripts.//: The full production pipeline. `gen:data` needs DB credentials; see README.
scripts.build: npm run gen:data --prefix web && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.dev: npm run gen:wrangler-config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run gen:wrangler-config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run gen:wrangler-config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && npm run gen:wrangler-config && wrangler deploy --env dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dev:dry: npm run gen:wrangler-config && wrangler deploy --env dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --dry-run
